ideas.title: Minnesota Medicaid Program Vulnerable to Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the root causes of the $91 million funding deferral and potential fraud within Minnesota's Medicaid program
questions: What are the specific vulnerabilities in the Medicaid program?
ideas.insight: The deferral of $91 million in Medicaid funding indicates a significant issue with the program's integrity. Investigating the causes and extent of this fraud could uncover a large-scale scheme.

ideas.title: Feeding Our Future Program Under Scrutiny
ideas.description: Investigate the operations and potential fraud within the Feeding Our Future program following whistleblower leaks
questions: What are the details of the leaked documents?
How do these leaks indicate potential fraud?
ideas.insight: The repeated leaks by Aimee Bock suggest ongoing issues with the program. Analyzing these leaks and investigating the program's operations could reveal significant fraud.
